description: This file defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for a career path planning application, including user profiles, career plans, goals, roles, competencies, and their relationships.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user profile with minimal info, linked to career plans.

classes.name: CareerPlan
classes.description: Represents a user's career plan containing multiple goals.

classes.name: Goal
classes.description: Represents a goal within a career plan.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Catalog of roles with unique code and summary.

classes.name: Competency
classes.description: Catalog of competencies with code, name, and category.

classes.name: RoleAdjacency
classes.description: Weighted edges indicating adjacency or similarity between roles.

methods.name: mapped_column
methods.description: Defines columns in ORM models with types and constraints.
